classes.title: Listen and sway
classes.goal: Hear the whole song and move to the beat
classes.parentTip: Sit together at the piano. Sway side to side while the song plays.

classes.title: Find the beat
classes.goal: Tap a steady beat while the grown-up plays the tune
classes.parentTip: Any key is fine. Tap with your child's hand at first, then let go.

classes.title: Find the special note
classes.goal: Find and play the song's special note: G
classes.parentTip: Help your child find G. Use one finger and press gently, like a button.

classes.title: G up high
classes.goal: Find the special note in a second place on the piano
classes.parentTip: Notes repeat every eight white keys. Let your child hop between the two Gs.

classes.title: Echo me
classes.goal: Copy short 2 and 3 note patterns from the song
classes.parentTip: Watch first, then copy. If it's tricky, play just the first key together.

classes.title: Echo me again
classes.goal: Copy short 2 and 3 note patterns from the song
classes.parentTip: Watch first, then copy. If it's tricky, play just the first key together.

classes.title: Special note in the song
classes.goal: Play the special note at the right moments in the song
classes.parentTip: You play the blue keys, your child plays the coral one. Waiting is part of the game.

classes.title: Add a second note
classes.goal: Play two special notes, G and A, in the song
classes.parentTip: Two notes means more waiting and watching. Celebrate each coral key your child catches.

classes.title: Play together
classes.goal: Play the whole song together at full speed
classes.parentTip: Keep playing even if your child misses a note. The beat matters more than being perfect.

classes.title: Concert time
classes.goal: Play the whole song from start to end and celebrate
classes.parentTip: Clap, cheer and bow together. Mistakes are fine. The fun is playing to someone.
